title: Resend webhook endpoint gets disabled after repeated failures and events stop
symptoms: Email from Resend saying the webhook endpoint was disabled
No more email.delivered or email.bounced events
Same event processed several times before the endpoint was disabled
cause: Failed deliveries retry on a schedule that runs from immediately to roughly 28 hours later, and an endpoint that keeps failing is disabled automatically. Slow handlers produce repeats that look like duplicates.
fix: Return 2xx fast and process in the background, dedupe on svix-id, then re-enable the endpoint in the dashboard and replay the missed messages.
apply: Resend dashboard > Webhooks > endpoint > Enable, then open each failed message > Replay
affected: Resend webhooks, retry schedule as of 2026-10
